item_7_the_subtle_one: PASS decisively. With the panel open, Shift+Tab parked focus on e154 (Back to School Promo) OUTSIDE the panel; Escape closed it and focus STAYED on e154 rather than being yanked to the e92 opener. Corroborated by a second variant (Tab past document end -> Escape -> no reclaim). This is the behaviour the before-the-DOM-patch activeElement read exists to protect.

Unit-verified via RED-A, browser-unverified. NOT-RUN, never assumed.

It is actually aria-label = VC_SCHEDULER.MORE_EVENTS, rendering as More events. Established properly by diffing MonthMorePopover.vue at #349 vs main via the API (the agent's own inference used the restored #349 clone, which is #349 by construction, so its reasoning was invalid even though its live observation was right). The name is IDENTICAL at #349 and main — unchanged by #350, so not a regression, and VCST-5671's focus entry/restore also still work.

bugs_not_filed: I1 — Escape from QUICK-CREATE leaves no focused element: its opener is a non-focusable day cell, so a keyboard user is dropped to body. Pre-existing, not a #350 regression (pre-fix it had no focus management at all). Same defect CLASS as VCST-5813 (focus dropped to body with no repair target), so it may be worth folding into that line of work rather than filed alone.
I2 — the Loading story nests ~40 role=status live regions inside an outer status 'Loading events…' — a plausible screen-reader announcement storm, unverifiable without an AT pass.

I3 (orchestrator's own finding) — the overflow popover's aria-label 'More events' OVERRIDES its visible date header, so a screen-reader user loses the date a sighted user sees. Same class as the VCST-5803 timed-chip 24h/12h mismatch. Not a #350 defect and out of this ticket's scope, but it also means the dev's comment describing that name as 'the formatted date' is inaccurate.
